verdict.rationale: Loops' API docs point users to an OpenAPI spec for toolchains, validation, and client generation. A live probe confirmed https://loops.so/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so the spec is publicly downloadable and machine-readable. Missing for 10: no evidence on how complete or current the spec is relative to the full API (e.g., Content/workflow endpoints), and no independent hands-on corroboration of using it for client generation.
